name: Imago
original_description: Imago is a visual-first image creation and editing studio for ChatGPT and Codex. Create images, edit supplied photographs and artwork, keep subject and brand details consistent, and turn verified documents and data into thoughtful infographics and static visual explanations. Focused workflows cover references, posters, social designs, product visuals, icon concepts, screenshot redesign, storyboards, text accuracy, visual QA, and multi-turn refinement. When an image is requested and a native image tool is available, make the visual rather than merely describing an image prompt. It does not run its own image-generation service, invent statistics, guarantee pixel-perfect edits, or create editable source files without suitable tools.
summary_ja: 画像制作・編集や、確認済み資料を使った図解の作成を支援する。
limitations_ja: 独自の画像生成サービスは持たず、ネイティブ画像ツールの有無に依存。完全な画素単位の編集や適切なツールなしでの編集可能なソースファイルを保証しない。
